notes:
Primary contact: CTO Arjun Patel. Building JetBrains (IntelliJ/PyCharm) plugin that does local repo indexing + fast token streaming for completions. Key asks: 
- Local indexing: index large mono-repo on dev machine, minimal telemetry.
- Low-latency streaming: sub-40ms per token target for completions in active editing (single-file and multi-file contexts).
- Model/version pinning: must pin to specific quantized model revision for reproducible behavior across releases.
- Fallback routing: local small quantized model for offline, hosted Redwood for heavy transforms; prefer deterministic routing policy.
- Data controls: never send raw file contents unless flagged; need retention controls and audit logs.
Quote from CTO: "We cannot ship a copilot that leaks proprietary snippets — local-first indexing is a hard requirement."
POC asks: integrate Redwood SDK into plugin, measure cold-start kv cache population time, measure per-token latency streaming vs local model.
Requested artifacts: security FAQ, sample plugin integration guide, perf benchmarks for JetBrains IPC vs websocket streaming.
Sales notes: good fit for Private or Dedicated with on-prem model option; mid-market budget but heavy emphasis on security and determinism.
